findings.quote: And at night they come back down because the darkness makes it hard to see, and because in the darkness it is harder to follow a path you know by day.
findings.claim: "Darkness" repeats within the same sentence in close proximity.
findings.fix: Use "darkness" once, e.g. "because the darkness makes it hard to see, let alone follow a path you know by day."
